name: gethome
description: Build on a gethome hub: software that uses a home through an API key, and DIY devices that join it over MQTT.

interface.shortDescription: Build software and devices for a gethome home
interface.longDescription: Two skills for a gethome hub, the local smart-home hub: write scripts, dashboards, bridges and agents against its REST and WebSocket API with an API key, and make DIY boards appear as native devices over its MQTT broker.
defaultPrompt: Write a script that switches my porch light on at dusk through my gethome hub.
Make my ESP32 relay board show up as a device in my gethome home.
